readme: Localization evidence for the Pages site, one row per canonical feature. The site localizes through its own COPY table and static-copy catalog rather than the console boundary, because it is a separate artifact that ships without the renderer. `copyKeys` names the entries a feature depends on; a row is `localized` only when every one of them exists in site/app.js, so this file is checkable against that source rather than asserted. PAGE_COPY_INVENTORY checks the 12 dynamic surfaces and 6 five-level COPY keys, while the static catalog records every scanned text node and aria-label, placeholder, or title attribute with its missing count. Technical and factual text remains exact, and generated Cantonese boundaries are labelled honestly. The contract test recomputes every state and fails on any row that disagrees.

language-modes.mechanism: console/site/app.js -- the COPY table (per-key en/zh variants at four funny levels), copyText() as the selector, and applyVocabularyText() over the result

funny-levels.note: The site has a working language mechanism (COPY/copyText, both funny sliders, live vocabulary) but no COPY entry covering this feature, so its copy renders English in every mode. Missing translation, not missing wiring.
